top_signals.title: BP Profit Hits 18-Year High as Oil Refining Margins Surge
top_signals.summary: BP Plc said profit surged to the highest in 18 years as soaring refining margins boosted earnings, giving Chief Executive Officer Meg O’Neill a powerful tailwind as she seeks to turn around the beleaguered British energy major.
